publication_revisions.abstract: We report 4 ZTF superluminous supernova candidates selected by our software filters and subsequent human vetting. In this sample, a typical rise time is longer than 30 days and a typical peak r-band magnitude is 19-20 mag. We encourage spectroscopic classifications.
publication_revisions.authors_text: Ragnhild Lunnan (OKC), Daniel A. Perley, Jacob Wise (LJMU), Lin Yan (Caltech), Etienne Russeil, Yang Hu, Claudia Skoglund, Jesper Sollerman (OKC), Steve Schulze (WIS),Ting-Wan Chen, Aiswarya Sankar.K, Amar Aryan (NCU)

reported_assertions.remarks: Rising for 40 days, currently r=19.0 mag, g-r=0. Blue extended host visible in LS but no photo-z available.
Slow rise with some wiggles for 55 days, currently r=19.4 mag. Host photo-z of 0.35 ± 0.09 (SDSS)
Rising for more than 60 days with g-r=0, last detection g=19.8 mag. In outskirts of host with SDSS photo-z 0.27 ± 0.06.
Currently at peak after a 30-day rise, g=19.9 mag and g-r=0. Hostless to the depth of LS and PS1.
